issues.description: The problem statement and UML expect a custom toString() that returns a String, but the solution implementation declares @Override public Object toString() which is incompatible with java.lang.Object.toString() (which returns String). This will cause a compilation error and contradicts the expected method signature, confusing students about the correct return type.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the toString method in the solution (and ensure the template guidance) to match the standard signature: public String toString() and return a String. For example: @Override public String toString() { return "Lecture{" + "lectureName='" + lectureName + '\'' + ... + '}'; }
